reconstruction_summary: Reimplemented agent's V4 (ST-understeer + per-segment straight-bias removal + per-segment LS gain clipped to [0.7,1.5]) exactly as defined in out/analyze.py pred_v4, using their hardcoded Mach-E parameters (L=2.984, m=2336, l_f=1.313, l_r=1.671, C_f=286551, C_r=355912, tau=0.08).
notes: V4 declared best in REPORT.md variant ladder table (lowest RMSE of all variants). Agent's V4 hardcodes Mach-E geometry/tyre constants but is applied here to both Mach-E and F-150 Lightning segments per the canonical eval set; the in-sample per-segment bias-and-gain post-processing absorbs much of the platform-parameter mismatch, so pooling stays valid. Recomputed V0 baseline matches the cached canonical value to ~1e-15.
